title: $40 Billion Vanished in One Week #shorts
description:
In May twenty twenty-two, the TerraUSD stablecoin lost its dollar peg and its sister coin Luna went from over one hundred dollars to almost nothing in days.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Would you have trusted a coin that paid twenty percent a year, or seen the trap coming? 👇

lines.text: Forty billion dollars vanished in a single week.
Inside a coin that promised it could never lose value.
TerraUSD was a stablecoin, always worth exactly one dollar.
No cash backed it. Just code, and a sister coin called Luna.
A lending app paid nearly twenty percent a year to hold it.
Billions poured in. Luna hit over one hundred dollars.
Then, in May twenty twenty-two, big holders started selling.
The dollar peg broke. The code printed trillions of Luna to save it.
Luna fell to a fraction of a cent.
Forty billion dollars, gone in seven days.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
